_comment: Look library v3 additions (docs/LIBRARY_V1.md, section "Library v3"). Same schema and camera-feasible controls as library_v2.json; WB values are camera steps (~4.4 %/step). Sources per recipe in "source" and in the doc.

lib3_kchrome25.name: Kodachrome25
lib3_kchrome25.description: Kodachrome 25 slide: dense, cool-neutral, rich reds, muted cyans/greens, deep shadows.
lib3_kchrome25.source: GarethB, mu-43.com "My Kodachrome / Classic Chrome Pen-F settings" (2017): colour profile, contrast +2, H-2 M+3 S-5, WB A-2 G+2 (bundle uses A0 G+1: the source WB rendered too cold in the sim). H/L added here.

lib3_fuji200.name: Fujicolor200
lib3_fuji200.description: Fujicolor C200 consumer negative: warm yellows, fresh greens, punchy but soft-contrast.
lib3_fuji200.source: James Bloomer, om-recipes.com "OM-3 Fujicolor 200" (2026): contrast -1, H0 M+1 S-3, Auto WB (Keep Warm off) A2 G1. H/L added here.

lib3_cibachrome.name: Cibachrome
lib3_cibachrome.description: Ilfochrome/Cibachrome print: glossy, saturated magenta-reds, deep blues, rich darks.
lib3_cibachrome.source: Jay, om-recipes.com "Cibachrome Print": contrast +1, H-3 M+1 S-2, 5300K A1 G-1. H/L added here.

lib3_portra160.name: Portra 160
lib3_portra160.description: Fine-grain portrait negative: natural, slightly cool skin, quiet greens, soft contrast.
lib3_portra160.source: Isaac Mitropoulos, om-recipes.com "Portra 160": contrast -1, H-1 M0 S+1, 5300K A0 G0. H/L added here.

lib3_ultramax.name: UltraMax 400
lib3_ultramax.description: Kodak consumer negative: warm, punchy reds and yellows, olive greens, visible grain.
lib3_ultramax.source: Own design from the stock's published character (no Olympus/OM recipe with numbers found).

lib3_superia.name: Superia 400
lib3_superia.description: Fuji consumer negative: green-leaning, cyan skies, warm-ish base, lively mids.
lib3_superia.source: James Bloomer, om-recipes.com "Fujicolor Superia Premium 400" (2026): contrast -1, H+1 M+1 S0, Auto WB (Keep Warm off) A3 G1. H/L added here.

lib3_agfa.name: Agfa Vista
lib3_agfa.description: Agfa Vista 200: vivid, slightly magenta reds, deep blues, cool cheap-film punch.
lib3_agfa.source: Own design from the stock's published character (no Olympus/OM recipe with numbers found).

lib3_cs50d.name: CineStill50D
lib3_cs50d.description: Daylight cinema stock: clean, slightly cool, rich blues, soft highlights, faint red glow.
lib3_cs50d.source: Own design from the stock's published character (no Olympus/OM recipe with numbers found).

lib3_v250d.name: Vision3 250D
lib3_v250d.description: Kodak daylight cinema negative: flat, wide latitude, gentle teal/orange separation.
lib3_v250d.source: Own design from the stock's published character (no Olympus/OM recipe with numbers found).

lib3_v500t.name: Vision3 500T
lib3_v500t.description: Kodak tungsten cinema negative used in daylight: cool teal cast, warm lights, open shadows.
lib3_v500t.source: Own design from the stock's published character (no Olympus/OM recipe with numbers found).

lib3_polaroid.name: Polaroid
lib3_polaroid.description: Integral instant film: faded, low contrast, warm highlights, cyan-green shadows, muted blues.
lib3_polaroid.source: Own design from the stock's published character (no Olympus/OM recipe with numbers found).

lib3_xpro.description: E-6 slide in C-41: hard contrast, yellow-green highlights, cyan skies, yellowed skin.
